evaluation.summary: 本轮 CRM 场景中，NocoBase3 的迁移/种子、Repository 查询与过滤、服务提供者与路由鉴权、客户端路由声明与请求/表单/本地化能力整体可直接使用，B01–B05 全量通过，未出现需要绕过框架的自造数据层或鉴权旁路。已确认一处指引缺口：nocobase-db Skill 未说明 belongsTo 的数据库外键与级联只在关系声明 constraints 时生成，应用为此重复声明 foreignKey；另建议为 Repository 聚合补最小示例，避免被应用层求和替代。评审未运行应用，且当前模型无法解码 PNG，故数据库物理结果与跨页面视觉一致性未验证。

modules.name: 数据库迁移、集合定义与种子

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md
entrypoints: 第 2 节 migration/seed 结构
第 3 节 Builder 与 relation/constraint

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/migrations.md
entrypoints: 数据库目录、db:apply 运行方式、验证清单
指向 nocobase-db Skill 的入口

modules.scope: 本次仅覆盖 customers/contacts/opportunities 三张表的迁移与种子：defineMigration/defineSeed 标记、builder.createCollection、fluent 字段与 belongsTo/foreignKey 约束、级联删除。未覆盖迁移回滚、校验和漂移、插件迁移、多连接与事务内建表。
modules.limitations: 未运行 db:apply，也未核对真实数据库物理 schema；级联行为仅由实现路径和 B01 的关联写入间接支持，未做删除测试。relation.constraints 的默认值只从 compiler 分支推断，未查默认赋值点。

requirements.need: 创建 crm_customers/crm_contacts/crm_opportunities 三张表，包含主键、字符串/整型/小数金额字段与索引。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineMigration、迁移发现标记与 CollectionBuilder 流畅字段 API；业务负责字段名、长度、默认值与索引选择。
requirements.recommendedUsage: nocobase-db Skill 第 3 节：builder.createCollection(name, callback)，在回调里用 increments/string/decimal 等声明字段，用 index/unique 声明索引。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用迁移严格按此写法，命名与字段声明与 Skill 示例同构；B01/B04 的写入与读取全部通过，未受阻。

requirements.need: 联系人、商机归属客户，并在客户删除时级联清理。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 relation（belongsTo）与约束（foreignKey）两类声明及其 onDelete 编译；业务负责选择归属字段与级联策略。
requirements.recommendedUsage: Skill 第 3 节把 relations 与 constraints 分列，示例用外键声明数据库约束；但未提到 belongsTo 需 constraints(true) 才发出外键，也未在文档化的关系选项里列出 constraints()。
requirements.actualUsage: 迁移同时写 belongsTo(..., onDelete:'cascade') 与显式 foreignKey(..., onDelete:'cascade')，并在注释中说明关系选项不足以发出级联；B01 的关联刷新与种子关联写入通过。

requirements.need: 安装种子数据可重复执行且不覆盖用户修改。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineSeed 与 seed context 的 repository；业务负责稳定的业务标识与幂等判断。
requirements.recommendedUsage: Skill 第 2 节：seed 无 builder，写安装数据用 repository，按唯一业务值幂等。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用按业务名先 findOne 再 createOne，并显式记录不使用 upsertOne 的原因；B01–B03 的样本数据来自该种子。

requirementFit.reason: 三表结构、字段类型、外键与索引都在冻结的 builder/fluent 实现中直接支持，迁移与种子写法与 Skill 推荐入口一致；仅关系级联需要额外显式 foreignKey 约束，属可用的小缺口。

usability.reason: createCollection + 回调式字段声明直观，字段/索引 API 齐全；但 belongsTo 的 onDelete 与 constraints 关系选项未在指引中说明，导致同一声明需写两遍更易出错。

agentFriendliness.reason: nocobase-db Skill 第 2/3 节和 migrations.md 明确给出迁移/种子形状与字段列表，入口可发现；但 relation.constraints 的缺失使 Agent 只能靠试错或注释确认级联，指引可补一句默认行为。

design.reason: defineMigration/defineSeed 只做标记以便加载器发现，schema 变更集中在 CollectionBuilder 与 compiler，relation 元数据与数据库约束职责分离，边界清晰。

reliability.reason: 读了 builder.apply 与 compiler 约束编译实现：foreignKey 约束会带上 onDelete，belongsTo 只在 relation.constraints 为真时才追加外键，与迁移写法一致；未运行真实数据库验证物理结果。

modules.name: Repository 查询、关联加载与过滤

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md
entrypoints: 第 4 节 Repository/Query 选择与搜索/分页/聚合
第 5 节排序与选字段

modules.scope: 本次涉及 repository.findMany/findOne/createOne/updateOne、字符串不区分大小写过滤、数字等值过滤、按客户过滤、sort 与 select/include 关联加载，以及聚合 API 的存在性。未覆盖分页游标、事务、groupBy 实际使用与 policy 绑定。
modules.limitations: 应用在服务层用 reduce 计算金额合计而未调用 repository.aggregate，因此聚合仅核对到公开签名与实现体，未验证其运行结果。关联加载只读到 select.include 的构造与 B01 刷新后的页面结果，未追踪底层 join 实现。

requirements.need: 客户与联系人列表支持按关键词模糊过滤，且大小写不敏感。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 FilterBuilder 与字符串操作符及 mode 选项；业务负责关键词字段与组合条件。
requirements.recommendedUsage: Skill 第 4 节：filter/select/sort 接受 builder 回调或 JSON AST；用 builder.string(path).includes(value, { mode:'insensitive' })，组合用 and/or。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在 listCustomers/listContacts 里用 builder.or + builder.string(...).includes(..., { mode:'insensitive' })，并由 B03 阶段过滤与列表行为验证。

requirements.need: 客户详情返回其联系人与商机（关联数据）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 select/include 关联加载与 relations 解析；业务负责返回字段与 DTO 形状。
requirements.recommendedUsage: Skill 第 4/5 节：select 回调用 include('customer', cb) 选中关联字段，字段名用 Collection 逻辑名。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在 listContacts/listOpportunities 用 select.fields(...).include('customer', ...) 取客户名；B01 刷新客户详情后联系人归属正确。

requirements.need: 客户详情的商机金额合计，并随商机金额变更更新。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 aggregate/groupBy；合计口径与舍入是业务规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: Skill 第 4 节把 aggregate/groupBy 列为 Repository 方法，可对集合做 count/sum 等聚合；示例未给出聚合写法。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用先 listOpportunities 取全部行，再在服务层 reduce 求合计并四舍五入；B02/B04 验证合计随商机金额变化。能力可用但未被采用，Agent 的发现过程未记录。

requirements.need: 创建/更新客户、联系人、商机并返回写入结果。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 createOne/updateOne 并返回 result.record；业务负责输入校验与字段规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: Skill 第 4 节：写操作返回结果对象，记录在 result.record；findOne/updateOne/deleteOne 的作用域约束。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用 createOne({ values }) 取 result.record，用 updateOne({ filter, values })；B01–B04 的增改均成功。

requirementFit.reason: 过滤、关联加载与增改都由冻结实现直接支持，且与 Skill 第 4 节的方法清单和 db-api 说明一致；金额合计虽由业务在 JS 完成，但框架聚合能力确实存在，未构成缺口。

usability.reason: builder 回调与 JSON AST 等价、and/or 组合自然，includes 的 mode 选项可直接表达不区分大小写；select/include 的链式写法与字段逻辑名一致，重复接入代码不多。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确列出方法与 filter/values/select/sort 接受回调和 AST，database-and-data.md 指向 Skill；但聚合只有方法名、没有示例，应用因此选择先取全量再求和的替代写法。

design.reason: Repository 只面对 Collection 记录并提供 find/count/aggregate/groupBy 等对称方法，过滤/排序/选字段统一为可序列化 AST，写操作返回结构化结果对象，公开抽象边界清晰。

reliability.reason: 阅读了 repository 的 prepareRead/normalizeFilter 路径与 filter-builder 实现，string.includes 会把 mode 写入节点，aggregate 会先 normalize 再校验字段；未运行聚合与分页，故不更高。

findings.title: nocobase-db Skill 未说明 belongsTo 的外键/级联需 constraints(true)，应用被迫重复声明 foreignKey
findings.detail: compiler 只在 relation.constraints 为真时才为 belongsTo 追加外键约束，onDelete 也只有在此时被带入；而 Skill 第 3 节把 relations 与 constraints 分列，既未说明该默认行为，也未在文档化的关系选项中列出 constraints()。
findings.impact: 按 Skill 只写 belongsTo(..., { onDelete:'cascade' }) 的迁移不会得到数据库级外键或级联，Agent 需靠实现或报错才知道要补显式 foreignKey 约束，容易出现重复声明或静默缺失约束。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-db Skill 第 3 节的 relation 列表与示例中说明 constraints(true) 控制是否发出数据库外键、onDelete/onUpdate 仅在该约束上生效，并给出一种推荐写法。

diagnosis.trigger: 迁移中用 belongsTo 声明关系并只依赖 onDelete，未设置 relation.constraints 或显式 foreignKey 约束。
diagnosis.expected: Skill 说明关系级联何时生成数据库约束，并让读者用单一推荐写法得到外键与级联。
diagnosis.actual: Skill 未记录 constraints() 关系选项；compiler 仅在 relation.constraints 为真时生成外键，应用因此同时写 belongsTo 与显式 foreignKey 并在注释中解释。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用显式声明 foreignKey('customerId', { references, onDelete:'cascade' })，代价是同一声明写两处且需自行保证一致。
diagnosis.acceptance: 更新 Skill 后，仅按文档写一种关系声明即可在 db:apply 后用 schema inspector 观察到对应外键及 onDelete 行为。

findings.title: Repository 聚合能力有方法名但无示例，容易被替代实现绕过

diagnosis.trigger: 业务需求为客户详情的关联金额合计。
diagnosis.expected: Skill 提供聚合方法的最小可复制示例，读者可直接下推求和。

createCollection 规范化回调定义后调用 apply 执行 createCollection 操作，dropCollection 对应 dropCollection 操作。
normalizeCollectionDefinition 仅当 relation.constraints 为真时才为 belongsTo 追加 foreignKey 约束；否则只补关系列索引。
关系构造器暴露 constraints(value=true) 与 onDelete(action)、onUpdate(action) 选项，写入 relation 定义。
迁移与种子的写法归 nocobase-db Skill 第 2/3 节；应用侧说明 db:apply 的运行顺序，并规定重复运行 seed 不得覆盖已编辑数据。
evidence.excerpt:
How to write the files themselves — the migration and seed shape, the immutability and self-containment rules, the Collection Builder, and which of `builder`, `query` and `repository` a task context should reach for — belongs to the package that owns them. Read `.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md` sections 2 and 3 before writing one, and run `pnpm skills:sync` if that file is missing.

Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm db:apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

evidence.observation: builder 是迁移专用 schema API；createCollection 采用回调；字段构造器列举 increments..native，关系为 belongsTo/hasOne/hasMany/belongsToMany，约束与索引为 primary/unique/foreignKey/index。
说明 filter/values/select/sort 接受 builder 回调或可序列化 AST，写操作返回 result.record，并列出 findOne/findMany/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy 等全部 Repository 方法。
evidence.excerpt:
Resolve the manager once — in a route factory, or as a constructor dependency of a service — not inside every handler. `db.repository()`, `db.query()`, `db.builder()`, `db.collections()` and `db.transaction()` take the connection name as their last argument and use the default connection when it is omitted, so single-connection code never names one.

`filter`, `values`, `select` and `sort` each accept a builder callback or the equivalent serializable JSON AST, and mean the same thing either way. They do not accept a shorthand string array such as `['id', 'name']` or `['-createdAt']`. Field names are Collection logical names, never column names. A write returns a result object — the record is `result.record`, alongside `result.version` and the created relation targets — rather than the record itself. `findMany` is awaited for an array or iterated asynchronously to consume a large result incrementally.

The methods are `findOne`, `findMany`, `count`, `exists`, `aggregate`, `groupBy`, `createOne`, `createMany`, `updateOne`, `updateMany`, `upsertOne`, `deleteOne` and `deleteMany`; `describeMutation` and `validateMutation` report capabilities and pre-validate input, and `withPolicy` returns a scoped Repository.

evidence.observation: Repository.findMany 返回惰性查询，findOne 要求 filter 或非空 sort，count/exists/aggregate/groupBy 均先规范化过滤与选择并套用读策略。
createOne/updateOne 接受 filter 与 values，经过规范化与写策略后交给 adapter，并返回结构化结果。
字符串操作符 includes/notIncludes/eq/startsWith 等把操作符写入条件节点；build 在 options.mode 存在时把 mode 合并进节点。
DefaultFilterBuilder 公开 and/or/variable 与 string/text/number/date/time/boolean/json/relation 分组入口。
应用侧通过 database.repository(collection) 处理集合记录与关系，database.query() 处理非集合结果集；权限由路由在进入 filter/values/select 前决定。
evidence.excerpt:
From there, `database.repository(collection)` is the default for a collection's records and their relations, `database.query()` is for a result set that is not any collection's records, and `database.transaction(fn)` groups writes that must succeed or fail together. Each takes an optional connection name and uses the default connection when omitted.

Keep `@nocobase/db` in `dependencies`, not `devDependencies`. The deployed server resolves it at runtime, and TypeScript also reads that declaration to infer the database configuration through the public package name; declaring it only as a development dependency can cause TS2883 in an installed application even while a source workspace builds successfully.

## Where data access belongs

Put queries in a service and call the service from the route, once more than one handler needs the same data or the logic is worth testing on its own. A route that only reads and returns a list may query directly.

Never expose a raw row shape as an API response without deciding what belongs in it. Internal columns leak through a select-everything query.

Neither Repository nor Query applies the application's permissions. The route decides what the caller may see and change before any of it reaches a filter, a values object, or a field selection — see [application permission development](authorization.md).

evidence.observation: 迁移用 defineMigration + builder.createCollection 建三表，字段含 string/integer/decimal，联系人/商机同时声明 belongsTo 与显式 foreignKey，onDelete 为 cascade。
种子用 defineSeed 并在 run 中从 context.repository 取三张表，按业务名先查后建实现幂等。
listCustomers 用 builder.or + string.includes(mode insensitive)；getCustomerDetail 取客户后并行加载联系人与商机，并在 JS 中 reduce 求 totalAmount。
listContacts 用 builder.and/or + number().eq 组合过滤，并用 select.fields(...).include('customer', ...) 加载客户名。
ServiceContainer 提供 instance/singleton/has/resolve/resolveIfCreated/assertAvailable；singleton 惰性构建，未注册 token 与循环依赖都会抛出带 token 名的错误。

evidence.excerpt:
- **The parent page must place `<Outlet />` itself**, where the child content should appear. Pages do not insert an Outlet automatically, and neither do `RouteChildPage`, `RouteDialog` or `RouteDrawer`; only a plain navigation group gets its Outlet from the route renderer.
- Child routes inherit the entry route's `auth` and cannot change it. Every child page declares `authz` like any page: `'skip'` when the parent page's check is enough, or its own request. A child page renders only after the parent page's check passes.
- Link to a child route with a relative path and keep the current query parameters: `<Link to={{ pathname: String(id), search: location.search }}>`.
- Route declarations have no `index` field. Do not invent an index route, and do not register a child route at the parent's own path; when "opening the parent URL shows a particular child page" is needed, use the redirect in section 4.
- Do not change the shell, the route renderer or the ServiceProvider to add a menu entry. Keep the CRUD resources that business code uses, but they produce no menu entries.
- Design paths around business needs; there is no fixed naming format. Do not write the deployment base path `/main`.

## 2. File layout

A page with child routes becomes a folder: the page itself is `index.tsx`, and each child route is named after its path segment and placed beside it. When a child route has children of its own, it becomes a folder too:

```text
client/pages/projects/
  index.tsx                  /projects                     List page; <Outlet context={{ reload }} /> at the end
  new.tsx                    /projects/new                 RouteDialog: new project
  detail/index.tsx           /projects/:projectId          RouteDrawer: project details; <Outlet context={...} /> inside the drawer
  detail/edit.tsx            /projects/:projectId/edit     RouteDialog: edit project, stacked on the drawer
  project-form.tsx           Form component shared by create and edit
  project-delete-dialog.tsx  Delete confirmation (AlertDialog, state inside the component)
  types.ts
```

- A fixed path segment uses a file of the same name: `/projects/new` is `projects/new.tsx`.
- A parameter segment uses a name that describes what the page is for: `:projectId` is `detail/`.
- Components and types used only by these pages stay in the same folder, not in `client/components/` (which holds components shared across the whole application).
- Keep components and constants in separate files: when one file exports both a component and a constant, Fast Refresh stops working and ESLint (`react-refresh/only-export-components`) reports an error. Put constants and types in a separate module such as `types.ts`.

Adding a set of child routes usually changes these files:

| File               | What to change                                                   |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client/routes.ts` | Declare the pages, menu entries and nested `children`            |
| Parent page        | Place `Outlet`; add links or tabs that point to the child routes |
| Child pages        | Default-export the page component                                |
| `client/locales/`  | Menu and page copy (`en-US.ts`, `zh-CN.ts`)                      |
| `tests/`           | The route test (see section 12 of `page.md`) and behavior tests  |

## 3. Four ways to present a child route

A child route renders in the parent page's Outlet. It can be displayed inline, or it can cover the parent page with one of the three components below:

|                 | Inline (tabs, etc.)                      | `RouteChildPage`                             | `RouteDialog`                          | `RouteDrawer`    |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| Position        | Where the Outlet sits in the parent page | Covers the whole content area                | Center of the page                     | Side of the page |
| Modal           | No                                       | No; the sidebar and header remain usable     | Yes                                    | Yes              |
| `breadcrumb`    | Omit                                     | Write (it is a destination)                  | Omit                                   | Omit             |
| `PageContainer` | None; uses the parent page's             | Adds its own                                 | None                                   | None             |
| How to leave    | Switch to another child route            | Breadcrumbs or browser back                  | Close button, Esc, backdrop, `close()` | Same as left     |
| Use for         | Page tabs                                | Child pages with long forms or many sections | Create and edit forms                  | Record details   |

evidence.excerpt:
### ApiClientError

When the response is not 2xx, `api.request` throws `ApiClientError`:

| Field           | Contents                                                                                       |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `status`        | The HTTP status code                                                                           |
| `code`          | The business error code, taken from `error.code` or `code` in the response body; may be absent |
| `payload`       | The complete parsed response body, typed `unknown`                                             |
| `requestId`     | The `x-request-id` response header, for matching the error with server logs; may be absent     |
| `method`, `url` | The request method and full URL                                                                |
| `message`       | Taken from the error message the backend returned; **do not show it to users**                 |

- Network errors (offline, server unreachable) and cancellations do not throw `ApiClientError`; they throw fetch's own errors. In `catch`, write `error: unknown`, narrow it with `error instanceof ApiClientError` first, and only then read these fields.
- Handle only the errors you can handle; rethrow the rest for the caller.

### Handling each kind of error

Write the checks directly in the component that uses them (for example `ProjectSummary` above and `CompleteProjectButton` below); do not create an application-wide utility function for this.

| Case                       | Check                                                                    | Handling                                                                                                                                                    |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Record not found           | `error instanceof ApiClientError && error.status === 404`                | Say the record does not exist or has been deleted, offer a next step (close the overlay, go back to the list) and refresh the list; no retry (guideline R3) |
| No permission              | `error instanceof ApiClientError && error.status === 403`                | Say the user does not have permission; no retry (guideline S4)                                                                                              |
| Business error code        | `error instanceof ApiClientError && error.code === 'PROJECT_NAME_TAKEN'` | Show it below the matching field with `form.setError(...)`; see `form.md`                                                                                   |
| Other (network, 5xx, etc.) | None of the above                                                        | Say "The request failed. Please try again."; when loading data, offer "Retry"                                                                               |

- **Do not show raw messages from the backend**: the text in `error.message` and `payload` may be an English exception, a stack trace or SQL, and must not appear in the UI (guideline I3).
